# W12: Ebook Assembler

## USES N8N DATA TABLES

This workflow:
- Reads chapters from **chapters_data** table
- Reads outline metadata from **outlines_data** table
- Assembles complete Markdown document
- Saves asset record to **assets_data** table
- Writes final .md file to local disk

## SETUP REQUIRED
Create Data Table 'assets_data' with columns:
- asset_id (text)
- outline_id (text)
- title (text)
- subtitle (text)
- format (text)
- total_words (number)
- total_sections (number)
- estimated_pages (number)
- file_path (text)
- status (text)

## Output Files
- C:/dev/production_line/assets/ebooks/{title}.md

## Cost: ~$0.01 (minimal processing)
